Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) spectra in Figure 2d represented that Ni2P and Fe2P had the same hexagonal structures with a space group of P6̅2m. As the composition changed from Ni2P to Fe2P in FexNi2–xP, the (111) plane of the metal phosphides shifted linearly from 40.7° of Ni2P to 40.3° of Fe2P. Besides, the (002) plane of Fe2P appeared at 51.9° when Fe was enriched in TMP. The small peak shown at 33° in the Fe2P represents the (011) plane of the orthorhombic FeP phase. (25)
